title: PGM2: Recursive Construction of Nested Resolvable Designs and Associated Uniform Designs over GF(p)
description:
An R package for the recursive construction of balanced incomplete block designs (BIBDs), their successive generations, resolvable BIBDs and the associated uniform designs, derived from finite projective geometries PG(m, p) over a Galois field GF(p) of any prime order p.

Version 2.0.0 generalises the construction from GF(2) to any prime order, adds the direct constructor Qn() for the reduced stage designs and their uniform designs, and validates all outputs against the parameter tables of Boudraa, Gheribi-Aoulmi and Laib (2013).
